description: Source code for the TestTracing class in Playwright, managing trace collection, storage, and merging during tests.

classes.name: TestTracing
classes.description: Manages trace collection, storage, and merging for Playwright tests.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes trace options and starts live trace if configured.

methods.name: stopIfNeeded
methods.description: Finalizes and saves trace data, merging temporary files into a zip archive.

methods.name: appendForError
methods.description: Appends an error event to the trace.

methods.name: appendStdioToTrace
methods.description: Records stdout or stderr output into the trace.

methods.name: appendBeforeActionForStep
methods.description: Logs a 'before' event for a test step.

methods.name: appendAfterActionForStep
methods.description: Logs an 'after' event for a test step.

methods.name: _appendTraceEvent
methods.description: Adds a trace event to internal storage and live trace file.
